def factor_momentum_persistence_volume_smoothed(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret_20 = df_copy["close"] / df_copy["close"].shift(20) - 1.0
    up_days = (df_copy["close"] > df_copy["close"].shift(1)).rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
    _, _, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=20)
    raw = ret_20 * up_days * vol_ratio
    # Apply 3-day EMA smoothing to reduce noise and improve signal stability
    smoothed = raw.ewm(span=3, min_periods=3).mean()
    df_copy["factor_momentum_persistence_volume_smoothed"] = smoothed
    return df_copy["factor_momentum_persistence_volume_smoothed"]
description: Preserves the parent's core economic mechanism: multi-day momentum (20-day return) amplified by directional persistence (fraction of up days) and volume surge (vol_ratio from classify_volume_regime). A lightweight 3-day EMA smoothing modifier reduces short-term noise, targeting improved signal stability and ICIR while maintaining the trending behavior intuition.
